# Phase 0 scope review — per-word decisions, A1/A2

**Prepared:** 2026-09-24, for `docs/CURRICULUM_V1_2_PLAN_2026-09-24.md` Phase 0.
**Inputs:** `app_vs_official_summary.md` and the two CSVs next to it (generated by
`tool/official_lexicon.py`), `tool/curriculum_scope/level_scope.json`.
**Status:** decisions drafted; a qualified teacher of Czech as a foreign language
should confirm the *Extension* and *Recognition* calls before content changes ship.

Decision labels:

- **Keep**: in scope, or outside the word list but useful for the unit's topic.
- **Official form first**: keep the meaning, teach the form the official list uses,
  mention the app's current form as a variant.
- **Recognition**: understood in reading and listening, never required in a
  scored production item.
- **Extension**: moves to the unit's optional *Towards B1* lesson.
- **Remove**: not vocabulary (a grammar note or a mistake).
- **Fix**: spelling error in the app today.

## 1. Correction: which edition of the standard

The 24 Sep analysis first used a copy of the reference description found on
inkluzivniskola.cz. That copy is the **June 2015 draft** (294 pages). The official
file on cestina-pro-cizince.cz is the **final December 2016 edition** (312 pages,
SHA-256 in `official_sources.json`). Re-checked against the final edition:

- The grammar chapter is the same on every point the plan relies on: case scope,
  perfective forms "only for frequent verbs", passive-only *chtěl bych*, present
  conditional, the pronoun table, the clause types, *aby* as an A2 word plus
  *dovolte, abych vám představil/a*, no *kdyby*.
- The word list is larger: **3,164 rows** (3,132 distinct headwords); **1,216 A1
  and 1,383 A2 single words**. App coverage is unchanged in substance: at most
  **68% of official A1** and **38% of official A2** single words appear anywhere in
  the app (stem match, upper bound).

## 5. Topic gaps: official words the app never uses

The official standard uses the same 14 everyday topics at A1 and at A2. Share of
**official A1** words missing from the app, by topic (single words, upper bound):

| Topic | A1 words | Missing | Where the app covers the topic |
|---|---|---|---|
| Police and emergencies | 17 | 11 (64%) | No unit |
| Free time | 128 | 54 (42%) | U13 |
| Contact with Czech society | 48 | 20 (41%) | — |
| Offices | 44 | 17 (38%) | A2 U23 (partly) |
| Personal details, family | 133 | 47 (35%) | U2, U4, U8 |
| Travel | 99 | 35 (35%) | U14, U15 |
| Work | 95 | 34 (35%) | U5 |
| Shopping and services | 118 | 38 (32%) | U6, U12 |
| Food | 116 | 36 (31%) | U6, U11 |
| Health care | 101 | 31 (30%) | A2 U24 only |
| Housing | 85 | 23 (27%) | A2 U26 only |

**The finding:** the official A1 list includes practical words for health, housing,
offices and emergencies, but the app has no A1 unit for those topics. Examples of
official **A1** words the app never teaches at any level: *pohotovost* (emergency
room), *zubař* (dentist), *neschopenka* (sick note), *prohlídka* (check-up),
*poliklinika*, *poschodí* (floor), *ubytovna* (hostel),
*cizinec* (foreigner), *tlumočník* (interpreter), *důchod* (pension). Meanwhile U24
teaches *operační sál* and *bakterie*.

**Proposed handling (for the plan):**

1. Add **survival sets** as recognition vocabulary to existing A1 units, no new
   units: emergencies and health basics (*pohotovost, zubař, lékárna, prohlídka*) in
   U14 *Find Places*; housing basics (*byt, poschodí, nájem*) in U9 or U14; office
   words (*úřad, cizinec, tlumočník, formulář*) in U2 or U4.
2. In A2 U24 and U26, replace the extension words with the missing official A1/A2
   words for the same topic (*pohotovost, zubař, neschopenka, prohlídka, chřipka,
   kašel, horečka, prášek, tableta*; *poschodí, zařízený, nezařízený, náklady,
   rozbitý, téct, fungovat*).
3. Pick the rest from `official_words_missing_from_app.csv` by topic with the teacher.
   The v1.1 guardrail (10–14 active items per unit) still holds, so most additions are
   recognition vocabulary.

## 6. Other findings

- **U6 cheat sheet doesn't match the U6 lessons.** The lessons (reworked in v1.1)
  teach café orders with *-a → -u*. The cheat sheet still teaches *Vidím ženu. Mám
  psa.* and lists *psa, muže, studenta* as core vocabulary. The pilot model page
  replaces it (`docs/curriculum-v1.2/pilot_notebook_pages.json`).
- **Masculine animate accusative** (*psa, bratra*) is required at A1 and has a rule
  (GR-051), but no A1 lesson practises it. Suggested home: U8 *My Family*
  (*Mám bratra. Znáš Petra?*), together with the accusative pronouns (§7.1).
- **A2 lessons lack v1.1 metadata.** `can_do`, `new_language`, `recycles` and
  `exit_task` exist for 68 of 124 lessons: the A1 units reworked in v1.1. The A2
  units (e.g. all of U19) have none. The v1.2 rework adds them.

## 7. Confirmation of plan §7.3 placements

Checked against the current units and rules:

| Content | Placement | Confirmed | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Nominative/accusative plural | U16, before GR-152 | Yes | U16 Lesson B currently teaches genitive endings (GR-150/151) first; plural N/A becomes step 1 of the plural part |
| Animate masculine plural | U25 | Yes | Fits GR-240/241 (professions) |
| Personal pronouns, all cases | U17, U18 | Yes | GR-160 (dative) and GR-170/171 (locative/instrumental) are the natural hosts |
| Ordinals and dates | U20 | Yes | U20 is *Make Plans*; appointments need dates |
| Imperative | U23 | Yes | Next to GR-220–224 (modals), matching the official syllabus |
| Signs and reflexive passive | U23 reading | Yes | Replaces *zakazovat* with *zakázáno* |
| Adjectival nouns | U27 | Yes | *cestující* fits journeys |
| A1 accusative/dative pronouns | U6, U8 | Yes, with animate accusative added to U8 | See §6 |
